searchText: Can someone link me to the call? I'll hop on to discuss the JSON RPC stuff Could you please DM me your email address. I am going to send invitations today. I'll dig out our old Merge call list of participants, everybody who is not on the list and willing to receive an invitation, please, DM. Is the only way to get on the list to give you my email address? Or will the link be published somewhere prior to the call? It definitely will be, I think we will create an issue in the PM repo and post a link in discord prior the call **AllCoreDevs in 35 minutes** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/370 Stream: https://youtu.be/rlIgpf2V4ks Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 Also, a last minute addition on my end: clients' thoughts about London, how we can improve the process for the merge, and what their priorities are for the next ~6 months: https://hackmd.io/@timbeiko/london-retro Left a longer response about 2681/3338: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/370#issuecomment-902713690 I can't join from the beginning, but if this topic will be discussed ~15-20 mins in, then I'll be there. <@!425279588009246720> I'll make sure we discuss it when you're there 👍 Posted my own response as well Do we have a list of which clients will support eth/66? It seems like any clients that don't support eth/66 will see much degraded performance once geth drops eth/65 right?
